summary: Recorded every non-empty ConversationPlaybackFlush.id in telephony media, gRPC, and WebRTC output state so flushed response IDs cannot reopen after pre-audio or repeated flushes.
Kept flush idempotency by clearing provider/output buffers only on the first active flush while still clearing pause state and recording later flush IDs.
Changed telephony transfer discard so same-ID resumed audio can still play, but any response truncated by transfer is marked failed and cannot emit a successful playback completion.
acceptance_criteria: Flush-before-first-audio with a supplied ID blocks later audio for that ID.
A repeated flush with a new supplied ID records the new ID even when the transport is already flushed.
Pause is cleared by every flush attempt.
Provider clear remains idempotent for already-flushed telephony output.
gRPC and WebRTC apply the same no-reopen admission rule as telephony.
SIP transfer discard can resume audio for the same response ID but cannot produce a successful completion for the truncated response.
